title: Kinase assays
protocol: Stimulate OT-1 hybridoma T cells by incubating with 5 μg/ml anti-CD3 and 20 μg/ml anti-CD28 on ice for 30 minutes.
Crosslink the stimulated cells with 50 μg goat-anti-hamster antibody at 37°C for 30 minutes, maintaining a cell concentration of 5 × 10^7 cells/ml.
Lyse the cells in TNE buffer containing protease inhibitors and Na3VO4.
Clear lysates by centrifugation at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Set up immunoprecipitations using protein G beads and Dlgh1 or p38 antibody.
Tumble the mixture at 4°C for 1-2 hours.
In a final volume of 50 μl, incubate GST-ATF2 and unlabeled ATP with immunoprecipitates in kinase buffer on ice.
Add 20 μl of 5X loading buffer to stop the reaction.
